name: Thaumaturgy (Sielanic Path of the Silent Dead)

system.description:
Standard Power Progression — 2 Basic, 2 Intermediate, 1 Advanced. You must take the levels of a Discipline in order (all Basic before Intermediate, etc.). Powers from other sourcebooks are grouped under "Expanded Options" in the compendium.

  • Basic (2): Repel the Angry Dead, See the Dead
  • Intermediate (2): Army of Souls, Command the Freshly Dead
  • Advanced (1): Walk the Road of Shadows

Base rating-tracker for the Thaumaturgy (Sielanic Path of the Silent Dead) Discipline. Set the Rating field to your current level in this Discipline, and drag the individual Basic/Intermediate/Advanced/Elder powers you've learned from the Disciplines & Powers compendium into the Powers list below it.
system.source: Libellus Sanguinis II: Keepers of the Word, Book Two: Usurpers (Tremere)
